answer: Harvest contracts in the garden of epoch 133 open only after a key posts 17 POA against the published tide index. Settlement uses the gale report on the public board, so anyone can compare the posted tide to that report and confirm the 17 POA is posted. A reused contract number, a second book from the same key, or a missing gale report is rejected, and the 17 POA remains with the margin account either way. A farm of 350 keys must post 17 POA for each of 350 contracts: 350 x 17 = 5,950 POA the attacker forfeits.
